* * *

CACI is seeking a Master HVAC Technician to support our program in support to our mission critical client in Iraq.

What You’ll Get To Do

As the selected candidate, you will perform inspections on HVAC systems and components (e.g. heating units, building exhaust fans, ventilation units, etc.) to evaluate condition, identify necessary repairs and recommend or perform preventive maintenance. Cleans, lubricates, and repacks the working parts of the system.

More About The Role

  • Tracks performance of routine and preventative maintenance to ensure availability of HVAC systems and troubleshoot HVAC/R systems with complex problems and extensive repairs requiring judgement to locate malfunctions.
  • Respond to service calls and preventive maintenance inspections and produce reports in writing through computerized maintenance management system (CMMS) regarding malfunctioning/inoperable equipment.
  • Responds to emergency situations during and after hours to resolve issues. Diagnoses causes of problems and/or failures in HVAC systems for the purpose of identifying equipment and/or systems repair and/or replacement needs.
  • Install, repair, and maintain large commercial and industrial ventilation, refrigeration, air conditioning (AC), and cooling systems with complex problems and extensive repairs.
  • Independently perform recurring work on exhaust fans, boilers, air handlers, pump, motors, air dryers, and other related HVAC equipment but not limited to HVAC control and monitoring systems.
  • Installs, modifies, overhauls, repairs, and maintains a variety of complex HVAC equipment air conditioning, air handlers, pumps, motors, valves, heating systems, and associated auxiliary and control equipment.
  • Works with engineering or scientific personnel to discuss plans, modifications, and user needs. Reviews available plans, specifications, or drawings; determines the size, shape, and location of equipment.
  • Performs design, modification, maintenance and repair of critical environmental and energy support systems and associated highly sensitive state-of-the-art computerized controls and air quality monitoring systems located within US-Only areas of Intelligence and Security Command (INSCOM) Sensitive Compartmented Information Facilities (SCIFs).
  • Produces classified technical documentation outlining in depth technical findings and recommendations.
  • Provides design, emergency non-routine fault isolation of smoke removal systems, fire detection/suppression equipment used exclusively in critical, highly sensitive Military Forces installations.
  • Performs system and subsystem diagnostics and scheduling and maintaining complex electronic environmental systems, calibration, and lubrication of unique components and controls that are used to provide and monitor precise environmental conditions within SCIFs housing unique military intelligence equipment, scientific devices, and technologies.
  • Performs periodic, worldwide deployments in strategic and tactical mobile facility environments. Provides expert technical assistance for a 24-hour operational environment with limited documentation resources.
  • Responds to off-duty (evening and weekend) calls to support critical system outages and to provide rapid fault isolation and resolution concerning environmental factors affecting ISR system performance to include developing technical documentation for ISR support system layouts.
  • Supports US Army systems on site whenever and wherever deployed. Available to deploy to other countries and/or theaters to perform quick reaction technical support to US forces worldwide military contingency missions and requirements in potentially hazardous work environments.
  • Able to maneuver in small spaces and lift up to 50lbs.

You’ll Bring These Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree and three years of experience College, Vocational School, or High School diploma or equivalent and a combination of 10 years’ education and experience with a valid Master HVAC license, or equivalent, at a State level; or 12 years’ experience in an equivalent Military HVAC training/certification.
  • Specific experience in fault isolation and resolution of tactical and strategic environmental systems and their sophisticated electronic support systems.
  • Ability to plan, install, troubleshoot and repair equipment and systems not fully covered by technical manuals, schematics, etc.
  • 4 years’ experience with HVAC control and monitoring systems and their components.
  • Experience with computerized maintenance management systems (CMMS).
  • Expert level experience in design, installation and sustainment of computer controlled environmental systems in mobile secure facilities.
  • Required to meet US Government accepted and industry standards criteria for technically complex computer environmental systems, uninterrupted power distribution systems, and power control equipment.
  • Possess a North American Technician Excellence (NATE) certification.
  • US Citizen. Active TS/SCI clearance REQUIRED.

  • Our employees value the flexibility at CACI that allows them to balance quality work and their personal lives.

  • We are mission-oriented and ever vigilant in aligning our solutions with the nation’s highest priorities.
  • For over 60 years, the principles of CACI’s unique, character-based culture have been the driving force behind our success.

MISSÃO DO CARGO

Se você é um fisioterapeuta que acredita na transformação do cuidado à saúde, venha fazer parte da nossa equipe e ajude a moldar o futuro da saúde no Brasil. Our #oneteam is proud to be among the Best Workplaces in Europe and certified Great Place to Work across our offices. Here, there’ll be no average day for you. Ready to Press Play on Potential?

Let’s start with the role

We are looking for an experienced and highly skilled Principal Database Administrator to join our team. In this role, you will be responsible for maintaining, troubleshooting, and optimizing our MS SQL Server environments, with a strong focus on availability, security, and performance. You will play a key role in ensuring the continuous operation of our databases, particularly in complex, high-availability scenarios such as Availability Groups. In addition, you will bring your knowledge of alternative database engines like MongoDB and CockroachDB, as well as your expertise in cloud-based database administration.

As a Principal Database Administrator, you will:

  • Provide comprehensive day-to-day support, monitoring, troubleshooting, and administration for multiple MS SQL databases, with a particular focus on high-availability configurations like Availability Groups.
  • Diagnose and resolve complex performance and availability issues, with in-depth root cause analysis to prevent future occurrences.
  • Oversee database maintenance processes, including performance tuning , index management, and job automation, ensuring optimal operation.
  • Develop and enforce policies for backup and recovery , ensuring database resilience and disaster recovery readiness.
  • Apply security patches , conduct version upgrades, and enforce strict compliance with database security best practices.
  • Handle support calls and resolve technical issues swiftly, including response to security incidents and operational challenges.
  • Leverage expertise in alternative database engines like MongoDB and CockroachDB to contribute to cross-functional database projects.
  • Manage and optimize cloud-based database environments , ensuring scalability, performance, and reliability in cloud infrastructure.

What You’ll Bring:

  • Solidhands-on experience in MS SQL Server Database Administration in production environments.
  • Extensive experience with MS SQL Server database features, including Jobs Scheduling, Monitoring, Patching, Backup/Recovery, Replication, Availability Groups , and Always On configurations.
  • Proven expertise in diagnosing and resolving performance bottlenecks and availability issues .
  • Solid understanding of alternative database engines like PostgreSQL , MongoDB and CockroachDB , with practical experience in their administration and troubleshooting.
  • Proficiency in cloud database administration , with experience in cloud platforms like AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.
  • Fluency in English , both written and verbal, with excellent communication skills.
  • Strong teamwork, analytical thinking, and problem-solving abilities, alongside a proactive approach to continuous learning.
  • A commitment to mentoring and supporting junior team members.

MISSÃO DO CARGO

Como parte do nosso compromisso com um modelo inovador de assistência, buscamos Médicos Geriatras apaixonados pela transformação do cuidado à saúde no ambiente domiciliar, seguindo os princípios do modelo Buurtzorg, que prioriza o autocuidado e a manutenção das funcionalidades das pessoas em suas próprias comunidades.

  • Proatividade na busca de soluções que promovam a qualidade de vida e a funcionalidade dos pacientes.

Sobre Nós:

Na Laços Saúde, a diversidade é o coração do nosso trabalho. Acreditamos que cuidar é um ato de amor e acolhimento, e isso se reflete em nossa equipe, que é composta por profissionais de diversas origens e experiências. O modelo Buurtzorg que adotamos é mais do que um método: é uma filosofia que prioriza o cuidado comunitário, respeitando a individualidade e as necessidades de cada pessoa. Se você é um fisioterapeuta que acredita na transformação do cuidado à saúde, venha fazer parte da nossa equipe e ajude a moldar o futuro da saúde no Brasil. Aqui, cada dia é uma nova oportunidade de fazer a diferença na vida das pessoas.

Tem Paixão pelo Cuidado? Então junte-se a nós!

A Laços Saúde está pronta para receber você!

Vamos juntos cuidar da saúde da comunidade!

Proporcionar atendimento psiquiátrico de qualidade, acessível e humanizado através da telemedicina, promovendo o bem-estar mental e emocional dos pacientes. O médico geriatra deve atuar com empatia, responsabilidade e ética, garantindo diagnósticos e tratamentos assertivos, respeitando a individualidade de cada paciente e contribuindo para a melhoria de sua qualidade de vida. title: Operador de Suporte Técnico
description:
DESCRIÇÃO SUMÁRIA:

Colaborador fica responsável por realizar atendimento ao cliente, suporte especializado, ativações, conferência de caixa, abrir Ordens de Serviço e realizar agendamentos, configuração de rede, suporte à internet via rádio, configuração e solicitação de portabilidade, criação de novas linhas e realizar plantões de atendimento.

DESCRIÇÃO DETALHADA:

  • Atendimento ao cliente: utilizando as plataformas whatsapp e take bip, telefone, e-mail, SAC do site da empresa, realiza o contato com o cliente. Recebe também a demanda de atendimento dos demais setores (comercial e financeiro) quando o cliente não consegue contato direto com o suporte. Durante o atendimento, realiza a tratativa de acordo com a necessidade do cliente, identifica a origem do problema;
  • Suporte especializado: ocorre em 02 situações, sendo elas identificadas como link loss e luz do power (DYING GASP). As duas serão necessárias abrir O.S. para realizar a troca do modem;
  • Ativações: a partir da contratação realizada pelo cliente, o suporte colhe as informações do mesmo através do sistema (resgatando o atendimento) faz alteração das configurações necessárias, e permanece com o atendimento. Em seguida, utiliza-se o número de identificação FHTT e autoriza-se o cliente na base através do sistema (colocando as informações de caixa e porta) e por fim confere se o plano adquirido está correto; Ativação via sistema(MOBA) Nokia (ONU): preencher planilha de ativação, acompanhar ativação com o técnico e inserir no sistema, posteriormente seguir os procedimentos de ativação.
  • Conferência de caixa: após ativação o técnico de campo liga para o suporte fazer conferência da caixa para identificar os clientes ativos de acordo com o endereço para verificar quais portas estão liberadas;
  • Abrir ordem de serviço: após atendimento do cliente e de acordo com a sua necessidade, abre a ordem serviço dentro do sistema, posteriormente agendando na agenda técnica;
  • Configuração de rede: a partir da solicitação do cliente (ativação ou alteração), acessa o equipamento do mesmo e pede identificação (e confirmação dos dados/senha) para fazer a alteração necessária;
  • Suporte à internet via rádio: acessa o equipamento (rádio) do cliente e verifica se as configurações estão dentro do padrão, e caso não estejam destina-se um técnico ao local;
  • Configuração e solicitação de portabilidade: após contratação e coleta dos documentos (realizado pelo departamento comercial) é realizado o pedido de portabilidade pela plataforma NPAC. Após finalizado o processo de portabilidade é realizada a configuração e contato com o cliente a fim de instruí-lo;
  • Criação de novas linhas: após contratação de novas linhas telefônicas, é realizado a criação da nova linha, configuração e ao final realiza-se o contato com o cliente para instruí-lo sobre a linha. Após contratação de tv a cabo é realizado a criação e configuração do cadastro do cliente no BEENIUS;
  • Plantão: o plantonista (de acordo com escala) é responsável por organizar a agenda dos técnicos, tendo como prioridade os clientes que estão sem conexão;

description:
Diaverum is the global leader in renal care, focusing on improving the renal lives of patients—enabling them to live a full life.
With over 25 years of experience in renal care, we have been at the forefront of the sector ever since. Our operations currently span 24 countries, with over 14,000 motivated employees serving a patient base of more than 40,000 individuals.

Activities:

  1. Provide chronic dialysis therapy, including, but not limited to, the formulation of a dialysis plan with ultrafiltration, initiating dialysis through various access points, ensuring safety measures are met, and monitoring applicable vital signs for patients with chronic renal failure in accordance with the Care Plan.
  2. Prepare and administer medications, fluid therapy, or other treatments as prescribed by the doctor, and perform the necessary documentation in the patient’s record.
  3. Analyze patient data; assess and monitor the status of vascular accesses, review lab results, patient evaluations, and report any changes or abnormalities to the on-duty doctor.
  4. Monitor the dialysis water treatment system for use according to established procedures.
  5. Set up and check the functioning of hemodialysis machines, ensuring that all devices are clean, functional, and calibrated.
  6. Evaluate the patient’s clinical condition before and after the session, including vital signs and vascular access.
  7. Continuously observe vital signs and machine parameters during hemodialysis to ensure treatment efficacy and safety, adjusting blood flow and machine parameters as needed.
  8. Conduct a detailed initial assessment, gathering information on symptoms, medical history, and recent changes in health status.
  9. Inspect and care for the vascular access to prevent infections and complications, and provide the patient with home care instructions for the access point.
  10. Maintain detailed records on treatment, including vital data, machine parameters, and any adverse events. Ensure documentation is complete and accurate.
  11. Report changes in the patient’s condition and session results to the medical team and other healthcare professionals involved in care.
  12. Ensure all procedures are carried out according to the standards and protocols set by Diaverum Brazil.
  13. Provide ongoing education to the patient and their caregiver.
  14. Proactively participate in quality improvement programs.

Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree in Nursing
  • Registration with COREN
  • Experience in hospital procedures and Hemodialysis

title: Senior Pre-Sales Technical Advisor
description:
If you're seeking a career where innovation meets impact, you've come to the right place. As a global leader, Sovos is transforming tax compliance from a business requirement to a force for growth while revolutionizing how businesses navigate the ever-changing regulatory landscape.

At Sovos, we're dedicated to more than just solving compliance challenges – we're committed to making a positive and lasting difference in everything we do. Our teams operate on the modern edge of digital technology, working not only to solve complex business challenges but also to enrich our personal, professional, and local communities.

Our purpose-built systems provide the tools you need to thrive in a world where governments demand increased visibility, faster reporting and greater control over business processes. Excited about the possibilities? So are we!

Don’t worry if you don't check all the boxes – apply anyway! We're focused on hiring the right people, not just the "right" resume. It's not about what you've done elsewhere; it's all about what you're capable of doing here.

The Work You'll Do:

The Pre-Sales Engineer will work with the Direct Sales and Alliance teams to provide technical support during the sales cycle for our solutions, acting as the bridge between sales and product, professional services, and support. You will utilize technical expertise to support the sales team and deliver solutions that meet customer needs.

The Senior Pre-Sales Technical Advisor will be adept at leveraging technical expertise to deliver innovative solutions, ensuring seamless integration of product offerings with client needs. This role requires strong communication skills to enable effective cross-functional collaboration and the successful execution of complex sales initiatives. Known for developing robust sales strategies, conducting impactful product demonstrations, and providing comprehensive technical support to both clients and internal sales teams

More specifically you will:

  • Maintain an expert-level understanding of the functionality and technical architecture of our products.
  • Conduct the client discovery process to uncover unforeseen challenges and ensure the proper offering is being proposed.
  • Develop a firm understanding of customer needs, pain points, and requirements around the compliance process for the Brazilian market, aligning Sovos solutions to eliminate pain points and fulfill needs.
  • Work closely with Sovos’ Sales team to conduct sales and solution presentations for Strategic Enterprise and Mid-Size clients.
  • Design and deliver customized solution demonstrations using Sovos SaaS solutions and services.
  • Drive new brokerage sales opportunities with Alliances and work to upsell the current client base with account management.
  • Assist in the creation of RFP and RFI responses for prospective new clients.
  • Work closely with Implementation and Product Teams to ensure a seamless handoff from sales to onboarding for new clients.
  • Maintain and continually improve demonstration capabilities, conducting internal sales department training, demo system preparation, and proposal content development.
  • Act with integrity and demonstrate ethical behavior in all matters with stakeholders.
  • Take full responsibility for ensuring internal and external customer satisfaction.
  • Demonstrate initiative, drive, and determination to achieve results, success, and growth.
  • Maintain a high level of energy, enthusiasm, engagement, and commitment to action.
  • Demonstrate a high degree of self-awareness and a commitment to personal development and learning.

What We Need From You:

  • Bachelor’s degree in a related field or an equivalent combination of experience and education.
  • Strong knowledge of the Brazilian compliance environment.
  • Customer-facing experience is required.
  • Strong team orientation with a history of working collaboratively in a fast-paced environment.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and prioritize activities.
  • Thorough knowledge of MS Office software, including Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.
  • Self-motivated with a strong drive to succeed.
  • Moderate travel required for client meetings, trade shows, Sovos events, and special projects.

Essential Job Functions:

  • Interact effectively with teammates, colleagues, and customers.
  • Comprehend and communicate complex concepts.
  • Analyze and resolve complex problems.
  • Utilize technology (e.g., phone systems, computer hardware, and software applications) to fulfill work requirements.

What Does Sovos Offer You?

The tools to enhance your life - because we want you to enjoy your life outside of work and inside

  • Bi-Weekly Meeting Free Days
  • Globally recognized Training and Development programs
  • Virtual English Club through Rosetta Stone, and more!

Sovos is an equal opportunity employer committed to providing an environment that celebrates diversity and where equal employment opportunities are available to all applicants and employees. We do not discriminate against race, color, religions, national origin, age, sex, marital status, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic provided by law. At Sovos, all employees are encouraged to bring their whole selves to work.

Company Background

Sovos is a global provider of tax, compliance and trust solutions and services that enable businesses to navigate an increasingly regulated world with true confidence. Purpose-built for always-on compliance capabilities, our scalable IT-driven solutions meet the demands of an evolving and complex global regulatory landscape. Sovos’ cloud-based software platform provides an unparalleled level of integration with business applications and government compliance processes.

More than 100,000 customers in 100+ countries – including half the Fortune 500 – trust Sovos for their compliance needs. Sovos annually processes more than three billion transactions across 19,000 global tax jurisdictions. Bolstered by a robust partner program more than 400 strong, Sovos brings to bear an unrivaled global network for companies across industries and geographies. Founded in 1979, Sovos has operations across the Americas and Europe, and is owned by Hg and TA Associates. For more information visit and follow us onLinkedIn andTwitter .

Atividades que desempenhará:

  • Orçamento
    • Controlar o desempenho financeiro em relação ao orçamento aprovado.
    • Identificar desvios e propor soluções corretivas.
  • Fluxo de Caixa
    • Controlar e projetar o fluxo de caixa da empresa.
    • Identificar necessidades de liquidez ou excedentes para aplicação financeira.
    • Assegurar o cumprimento de compromissos financeiros.
  • Indicadores Financeiros
    • Analisar KPIs financeiros, como margem de lucro, liquidez, endividamento e ROI.
    • Elaborar relatórios com insights financeiros e tendências de desempenho.
    • Apresentar os indicadores à CFO e propor melhorias.
  • Contas a Pagar e Receber
    • Monitorar vencimentos e realizar previsões de pagamentos e recebimentos.
    • Negociar prazos e condições de pagamento com fornecedores e clientes.
    • Garantir a eficiência nos processos de cobrança e pagamento.

    • Emissão de Notas Fiscais: Emitir notas de produtos/serviços com informações corretas e classificação tributária adequada.

    • Atender as demandas das auditorias internas e externas.
  • Elaboração de Relatórios Gerenciais
    • Realizar os relatórios financeiros para subsidiar o controle de processos da área.
    • Alimentar os dashboards e painéis de controle para visualização de resultados financeiros.
    • Fornecer análises detalhadas para suporte à gestão.

title: Senior Technical Analyst - Cyber Security
description:
Senior Technical Analyst - Cyber Security

Company: Ball Corporation

Location: SÃO Jose Dos Campos, São Paulo, BR,

Date: Feb 20, 2025

Job Category: IT Administration

Req. ID: 41189

Further your career at Ball, a world leader in manufacturing sustainable aluminium packaging. Achieve extraordinary things when you join our team, and make a difference in your professional development, the community, and around the globe!

Please, submit your resume in English .

Ball Corporation is looking for a well-rounded team player with broad technical leadership skills to add to our Global IT Security operations department. This position requires extensive knowledge in three or more of the following IT Security tools: Firewalls, Web Content Filtering, Web Application and Malware Protection, Intrusion Prevention System, SSL Decryption, Email Security, Strong Authentication, Remote Access, End Point Protection, Advanced Threat Management, Vulnerability Scanning & Remediation, Identity Management, Data Loss Prevention, Data Encryption, Security Incident Management, Public Key Infrastructure, Web Application Firewall, IT Security Forensics, Password Vaulting, Risk assessment, and security vulnerability assessment.

This position works within the Global IT Security team to solve complex IT Security problems by taking a broad perspective to identify innovative technical solutions. The successful candidate will provide mentorship and guidance to junior level cyber security analysts. The position also participates in managing our vendors to achieve the desired results including quality and on-time delivery. Working knowledge and relevant certifications in the above security tools is preferred.

Essential Responsibilities

  1. Security administration is a hands-on role that requires a high level of technical expertise including networking, operating systems, applications, cloud environments, and security.
  2. Responsible for a broad range of security tasks, including the day-to-day security administration of network security devices, as well as the management of technologies, such as firewall, intrusion detection, intrusion prevention, data loss prevention, antivirus, anti-spam, antispyware, and security information and event management (SIEM) tools.
  3. Monitor, analyze, and respond to security incidents and breaches swiftly and effectively, minimizing potential impact.
  4. Lead incident response efforts, coordinate investigations, and ensure all incidents are properly documented and reported.
  5. Serve as a subject matter expert on cybersecurity matters, both internally and externally.
  6. Conduct regular security audits and assessments to identify weaknesses in networks, systems, and applications, and recommend remediation actions.
  7. Create and maintain system and network diagrams as well as process documentation.
  8. Provide support to ensure planning and deployment is accomplished in coordination with system owners, engineers, and stakeholders and are consistent with appropriate infrastructure and security engineering requirements.
  9. Assess and prioritize cybersecurity risks and vulnerabilities across the organization's technology landscape.
  10. Follow up on remediation of vulnerabilities.
  11. Participate in design and implementation of new security controls.
  12. Stay current with cybersecurity threats and trends, providing ongoing intelligence and insights to inform security decision-making.
  13. Create and modify procedural documentation as needed.
  14. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure compliance with regulatory standards and frameworks, such as SOX, HIPAA, or NIST.
  15. Develop and maintain incident response plans, disaster recovery plans, and business continuity strategies to ensure resilience in the face of cybersecurity threats.
  16. Ensure that all information systems operate in accordance with set standards.
  17. Participate in an on-call rotation with the department.
  18. Establish and maintain effective working relationships within the department, the Strategic Business Unit, and the Company.

Main Requirements/Knowledge

  1. Advanced Level of English.
  2. Experience in a cyber-security operations environment including 4+ years of technical leadership.
  3. CISSP, CISM, CISA certifications preferred; other security relevant certifications considered.
  4. Knowledge of CISCO ASA solutions specifically remote access.
  5. Technical “hands-on” proficiency with at least three security-related systems and applications.
  6. Technical proficiency with security-related systems and applications, especially mainstream OS’s.
  7. Experience in documenting and maintaining processes and procedures.
  8. Knowledge of information security principles, including risk assessment, intrusion detection, and network access control.
  9. Knowledge of network infrastructure, including routers, switches, firewalls, VPN, and associated network protocols and concepts.
  10. Knowledge of SANS Twenty Critical Controls information security policies, procedures, guidelines, and methodologies desired.
  11. A strong familiarity with cryptographic concepts and their practical application.
  12. Experience in securing Cloud environments such as Azure, AWS, SAP, etc.
  13. Knowledge and Understanding of the CI/CD Pipeline along with tools such as Jenkins and Bamboo.
  14. Experience in driving technology solutions in large, complex organizations.
  15. Proven focus in metrics-driven delivery: defining Service Level Agreements (SLAs), monitoring SLAs, and enhancing environment to meet SLAs.
  16. Experience in driving process and technology re-engineering using industry practices.

title: Operations Readiness & Start Up Manager
description:
NES Fircroft has a unique opportunity for a senior-level Operations Readiness & Start Up Manager, supporting the integration of a portfolio of high value projects into operations at a giant producing oilfield in Iraq.

The assignment is on a 12-month renewable contract, working on a 28/28 rotation.

Role synopsis

Our client is undertaking a large number of brownfield and greenfield projects in order to support and enhance production over the coming years.

This already complex field will increase in complexity requiring the incumbent to manage a challenging set of dynamic issues in the integration of the new projects into existing sites and the engagement of the site operations staff will be critical in ensuring the success of Rumaila for the coming years.

There is significant value at stake for this role to successfully manage a large project portfolio in one of the world’s largest oil fields, which comes with associated exposure to senior management.

The role ensures that the operational interfaces between operation and projects are effectively managed and with synergies maximised.

Accountable for driving continuous improvement across the projects start up & stay up.

The Operations Readiness & Start Up Manager functions under the Operations Organisation, reporting to the Senior Operations Manager.

The role includes significant people leadership and stakeholder management in an organisation of significant scale and complexity.

Key Accountabilities

  • Operations Readiness and Start-Up Manager is accountable to support projects and operations, acting as an interface in delivery of operations readiness for projects in service of safe, reliable and compliant start-up in the field.
  • Accountable for projects’ start-up in the field and pre-requisite activities to enable safe and efficient operations.
  • Understanding and experience in Operations Readiness & Assurance (OR&A) Delivery Requirements and project stage Gate readiness;
  • Proactive engagement with all operating departments to ensure the development will integrate into existing Brownfield Assets;
  • Promote a culture of safety and continuous improvement.
  • Accountable to interface with Project Management team at earlier stage of the project to ensure provision of Operations and Commissioning inputs and planning are considered to deliver the project in accordance with the Scope of requirements (SOR).
  • Establish an O&M strategy for startup and earlier Operations phases and ensure strategy is reviewed and accepted by all project stakeholders.
  • Manage the delivery of all required operational support contracts (such as Chemicals / vendor support agreements) to support the Asset in the Operate phase.
  • Develop an Operations readiness plan (ORP) including the key readiness elements and O&M deliverables for the required project phases including commissioning and start up and earlier operations, ensure they are communicated in timely manner to project stakeholders,
  • Interface with the Contract and Finance departments for Contractor Performance and financial controls
  • Liaise closely with the Project Manager to manage the interfaces, ensure alignment, and Identify areas of improvement, best practices, and lessons learned from other similar projects and implement.
  • Manage & maintain focus on operability & maintainability issues throughout all aspects of the project design & execution planning.
  • Develop and monitor key performance Indicators to measure the effectiveness of the different phases of the O&M Scope.
  • Support the project assurance processes (such as Model Reviews / Hazop, Hazid, etc).
  • Manage the acceptance & handover from Project to Operations using the approved certification process (such Guidance OF Certification) ensuring a structured plan is developed in advance and implemented at the different project phases.
  • Ensure that Contractor documents (Plans, Manuals, procedures, and Method Statements) are reviewed and commented by Operations and readiness team members.
  • Ensure start up and ramp up plans are developed taking inputs from project stakeholders to ensure flawless delivery.
  • Work in close collaboration with the Contractor Commissioning and Start-up Team to ensure commissioning and start-up activities are planned and scheduled in line with the project standards and procedures. This includes establishing Flawless Start-up strategy and implementation of the program as per project.
  • Manage the HSSE performance of contractors during execution phases to ensure HSSE targets are met or exceeded – make HSSE a priority. Run contractor performance review on regular basis.

Criteria & Qualifications

  • BSc or BEng (UK), or international equivalent in an engineering discipline, or equivalent experience
  • Professional accreditation, such as Professional Engineer or Chartered Engineer
  • Minimum of 10 years of experience in operations or engineering role, with at least 5 years in a management or senior leadership position, with significant experience leading Readiness delivery on major projects, with emphasis on Middle East and preferably in Iraq.
  • Good understanding of project management, commissioning and start-up procedures and hand over projects to Operations.
  • Business focused, able to priorities to maximize opportunities with no compromise on HSE.
  • Deep understanding of all aspects of delivering Operational Excellence in a large asset.
  • Track record of visible Safety Leadership and demonstrable risk management skills, with clear knowledge and track record of Control of Work, HSE leadership and major incident control.
  • High awareness of safe working practices associated with FEED, design, construction, pre-commissioning, installation, hook- up and commissioning of oil & gas facilities.
  • Familiar with projects assurance processes such as hazard analysis methods such as HAZOP, HAZID / What-if, LOPA.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills demonstrated in the leadership of operating teams, influencing on contractors and change management.
  • Strong influencing skills and a track record of delivery, action-orientated and value-based decisions; ideally in a JV environment
  • Experience in overseas posting working with diverse cultures would be beneficial.

With over 90 years’ combined experience, NES Fircroft (NES) is proud to be the world’s leading engineering staffing provider spanning the Oil & Gas, Power & Renewables, Chemicals, Construction & Infrastructure, Life Sciences, Mining and Manufacturing sectors worldwide. With more than 80 offices in 45 countries, we are able to provide our clients with the engineering and technical expertise they need, wherever and whenever it is needed. We offer contractors far more than a traditional recruitment service, supporting with everything from securing visas and work permits, to providing market-leading benefits packages and accommodation, ensuring they are safely and compliantly able to support our clients.

  • Colaborar com equipes de desenvolvimento para integrar soluções de segurança de forma eficiente.
  • Desenhar, avaliar e acompanhar a implementação de controles de segurança da informação para projetos de tecnologia no ambiente corporativo.
  • Ser o ponto focal no atendimento aos requisitos de segurança da informação, garantindo que as soluções atendam a regulamentações do setor e políticas internas da empresa.
  • Criar e manter instruções, procedimentos, métricas e dashboards para gestão dos sistemas implantados, promovendo os conceitos de Security by Design e Security by Default .
  • Avaliar riscos de segurança em aplicações, infraestrutura e ambientes de nuvem.
  • Liderar atividades de Design de Segurança da Informação, incluindo Arquitetura de SI, DevSecOps e Pentest.
  • Implementar e sustentar processos de Design de Segurança com monitoramento e KPIs.
  • Propor melhorias contínuas no processo de Design de Segurança em projetos de tecnologia.
  • Definir e implementar modelos de segurança de identidade, redes, criptografia e privacidade em ambientes multi-cloud e/ou on-premises.
  • Gerenciar procedimentos operacionais e administrativos relacionados à segurança da informação nos projetos.
  • Apoiar e liderar tecnicamente a equipe de segurança, fornecendo suporte e orientação.
  • Apoiar a gestão da Arquitetura de Segurança da Informação.

Requisitos técnicos:

  • Experiência comprovada em arquitetura de segurança da informação, com foco em autenticação de aplicativos.
  • Profundo conhecimento de protocolos de autenticação como OAuth, OpenID Connect, SAML, JWT, entre outros.
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de gerenciamento de identidade e acesso (IAM), CIAM e SSO.
  • Experiência em arquitetura de segurança para APIs.
  • Conhecimento em frameworks de arquitetura como BIAN e TOGAF.
  • Conhecimento em avaliação de riscos de segurança e no desenho de soluções adequadas.
  • Familiaridade com arquitetura de software, infraestrutura e metodologias ágeis (Kanban, Scrum).
  • Conhecimento em DevSecOps e ferramentas de automação de segurança.
  • Experiência em testes de segurança e análise de código-fonte.
  • Conhecimento em gerenciamento de riscos de segurança e soluções de segurança como PAM, DAM, SIEM, PKIs, EDR, IPS/IDS, SASE, DLP.
  • Expertise em metodologias de pentest como OWASP, PTES, NIST, entre outras.
  • Compreensão das melhores práticas de segurança, como GDPR/LGPD, ISO/IEC 27001, NIST 800-53, CIS Controls, PCI, e outras regulamentações aplicáveis.

Buscamos um profissional com sólida experiência técnica, capacidade de liderança e visão estratégica para garantir a segurança da informação em nossos projetos corporativos. Se você é apaixonado por segurança, inovação e desafios tecnológicos, essa vaga é para você!

  • Evaluate supplier performance and negotiate contracts for cost-effective procurement.
  • Monitor the quality and consistency of incoming products.

Reporting and Documentation:

  • Prepare and maintain accurate records of food and beverage costs and inventory.
  • Generate regular reports on cost control and inventory management for management review.

Additional Responsibilities:

  • Coordinate weekly inventory checks, providing detailed reports to the CFO/COO, along with action plans to address discrepancies.

  • Investigate any cost-related issues and provide action plans to rectify identified problems.

Requirements Qualifications and Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree in finance, Accounting, or a related field.
  • Professional Qualified Certification of ICWA, CMA.
  • Minimum of 7 years of relevant experience in food and beverage cost control within the HORECA industry.

Job Specific Skills:

  • Financial reporting and analysis.
  • Attention to detail and analytical abilities.

Competencies:

  • Cost-conscious mindset.

  • Communication and teamwork.
  • Adaptability and flexibility.
  • Knowledge of HORECA industry standards and practices.

Buscamos e valorizamos talentos, pessoas com personalidade, força de vontade e determinação.

RESPONSABILIDADES E ATRIBUIÇÕES

Este banco de talentos é destinado a candidatos que desejam fazer parte do nosso time, mas ainda não encontraram uma vaga ideal. Esperamos poder direcioná-lo para alguma oportunidade em breve.

Como funciona o nosso fluxo:

  1. Quando surgir uma vaga na sua cidade, buscaremos em nosso Banco de Talentos por candidatos compatíveis com o perfil desejado.
  2. Se você atender aos requisitos, entraremos em contato através do seu e-mail para convidá-lo a participar do processo seletivo.

Seguimos as determinações da Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados. Portanto, só poderemos movimentar seu cadastro entre as vagas se você autorizar, no seu cadastro, o armazenamento do seu currículo por tempo indeterminado.

O cadastro no Banco de Talentos não garante uma avaliação ou oportunidade imediata. Entraremos em contato quando houver uma vaga que corresponda ao seu perfil.

História do Grupo Mult

A trajetória do Grupo Mult começou com Maxwell Lage, que em julho de 1993 abriu uma revenda de automóveis multimarcas em Governador Valadares (MG). Com o tempo, a empresa se consolidou como uma das maiores na representação de veículos nos estados do Espírito Santo e Minas Gerais.

Para conhecer melhor essa evolução, confira a linha do tempo a seguir:

  1. 1993: Fundação em Governador Valadares (MG). Rápido crescimento, com filiais em Caratinga, Ipatinga e Teófilo Otoni.
  2. 2004: Tornou-se revendedor oficial Mitsubishi Motors e expandiu suas operações para outras cidades de Minas Gerais e Espírito Santo.
  3. 2012: Inauguração da Kobe Nissan, tornando-se referência nacional e recebendo a honraria Revenda Samurai.
  4. 2020: Tornou-se revendedor oficial Renault em Governador Valadares.
  5. 2021: Inauguração da Multicar Mega Store em Vitória (ES) e conquista da concessão da Royal Enfield.
  6. Hoje: Com 16 lojas, incluindo unidades Nissan, Mitsubishi, Renault, Royal Enfield e uma loja de carros esportivos, além de atuar nos setores imobiliário, de seguros e veículos por assinatura.

  • Provide guidance to technical and operational staff on procurement/compliance policies, in particular those contained in FAR, CFR, ADS, and AIDAR regulating procurement.

  • Organize and participate in internal evaluation committees.

  • Work with project leadership to answer any questions or provide USAID with any requested information about project procurements.
  • Other duties as assigned by the supervisor.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field required.
  • Minimum of three (3) years of procurement, subcontracts and grants required.
  • Experience working for USAID or other donor funded projects strongly preferred.
  • Demonstrable experience and understanding of procurement procedures of international organizations.
  • Strong organizational, management, and administrative skills.
  • Willingness and ability to work efficiently and respectfully with a diverse group of people.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office, in particular Excel, Word, SharePoint, and Outlook.
  • Demonstrated leadership, versatility, and integrity.
  • Proficiency in written and oral Arabic and English is required; written and oral fluency in Kurdish, and other local languages is a plus, but not required.

We are seeking a talented and versatile Brand and Creative Designer to join our growing aromatherapy company, Frank & Myra. The ideal candidate will have a strong passion for creating visually stunning designs that effectively communicate our brand story and values. As the lead designer, you will be responsible for developing and executing a cohesive visual identity across all touchpoints, from packaging to digital media.

Tasks

Key Responsibilities:

  1. Develop and refine Frank & Myra's brand identity, including logo design, color palettes, typography, and visual guidelines.
  2. Design compelling product packaging for our line of essential oils, hydrosols, and resins that balances aesthetics, functionality, and sustainability.
  3. Create marketing collateral such as brochures, flyers, catalogs, and point-of-purchase displays that engage customers and drive sales.
  4. Collaborate with the marketing team to design digital assets, including website graphics, social media visuals, email templates, and online advertisements.
  5. Produce outstanding product photography and lifestyle imagery that showcases our products and resonates with our target audience.
  6. Ensure brand consistency across all design elements and platforms, maintaining the highest standards of quality and attention to detail.
  7. Stay up-to-date with industry trends, consumer preferences, and emerging design technologies to continuously innovate and improve our visual communications.
  8. Work closely with cross-functional teams, including product development, marketing, and operations, to align design strategies with business objectives and timelines.
  9. Manage relationships with external vendors, such as printers and packaging suppliers, to ensure quality control and cost-effectiveness.
  10. Provide creative direction and mentorship to junior designers or freelancers as the company grows.

Requirements

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Graphic Design, Visual Communication, or a related field.
  • 5+ years of professional experience in brand identity development and packaging design, preferably in the wellness or beauty industry.
  • Strong portfolio demonstrating expertise in brand strategy, packaging design, digital media, and photography.
  • Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign) and other relevant design software.
  • Excellent understanding of color theory, typography, composition, and visual hierarchy.
  • Familiarity with printing processes, packaging materials, and sustainable design practices.
  • Exceptional communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.
  • Passion for wellness, natural products, and sustainable living.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Advanced degree in Design or a related field.
  • Experience with motion graphics, video editing, or 3D rendering.
  • Knowledge of UI/UX design principles and web design best practices.
  • Familiarity with aromatherapy, essential oils, and natural wellness products.
  • Entrepreneurial mindset and desire to grow with a small, mission-driven company.

Benefits

  • Flexible Work Arrangements
  • Professional Development
  • Wellness Initiatives
  • Community Engagement

At Frank & Myra, we are committed to creating exceptional products that promote well-being while adhering to the highest standards of ethics and sustainability. As our Brand and Creative Designer, you will play a crucial role in shaping our visual identity and communicating our values to the world. We offer a supportive, collaborative work environment, opportunities for professional growth, and the chance to make a meaningful impact in the lives of our customers and communities.

description:
Why the American University of Iraq—Baghdad?

Opening its doors in January 2021, the new American University of Iraq—Baghdad (AUIB) began as a dream of influential individuals in Iraqi and United States business, industry and government who want to see a world-class institution of higher learning established in the city, reminiscent of the days when Baghdad was an educational mecca and flourishing capital of the Muslim world. With a great library, palatial college buildings and student centers, state-of-the-art classrooms, laboratories, and athletic facilities, AUIB will be a beautiful campus, attracting students, faculty, and staff from throughout the world. We invite you to join us in this exciting new venture.

This position will report directly to the Dean of the College of Education and Human Development.

The American University of Iraq—Baghdad (AUIB) seeks a dedicated and efficient Executive Assistant to join the College of Education and Human Development (CEHD). As an American-style university, AUIB’s CEHD works in partnership with Vanderbilt University’s Peabody College of Education and Human Development to develop higher education for academic excellence and build a stronger educator workforce in the region. Supported by a two-year U.S. Department of State grant, Peabody College supports the Dean and ensures the smooth operation of the college and its administrative staff. The ideal candidate will work independently, be detail-oriented, possess strong organizational skills and excellent people skills, and be able to manage multiple tasks effectively in a dynamic environment.

Responsibilities

  • Serve as the senior staff member in the college overall, responsible for smooth functioning of the Office of the Dean.
  • Liaise with community partners in support of internships, capstones, and outreach programs.
  • Work directly with college faculty, supporting college events.
  • Provide comprehensive administrative support to the Dean, including managing calendars, scheduling meetings, taking minutes, and preparing documents.
  • Act as the first point of contact for the Dean’s office, handling correspondence and phone calls, ensuring effective communication with faculty, staff, students, and external stakeholders, and communicating through the college Canvas site.
  • Work directly with the faculty outreach coordinator to establish partnerships, internships and capstone relationships. Provide translations between English and Arabic as necessary.
  • Assist in organizing college events, including conferences, workshops, and faculty meetings. This involves coordination with various departments, managing logistics, and ensuring seamless execution.
  • Maintain and organize important documents and records for the college SharePoint document retrieval and archival system. Ensure confidentiality and accuracy in handling student records, faculty documents, and other sensitive information.
  • Assist in tracking the college’s budget, processing invoices, and handling expense reports as per the university’s financial policies.
  • Work closely with other administrative staff in the college and university to ensure cohesive team support and effective collaboration across units.
  • Take on special projects assigned by the Dean, which might involve writing reports, conducting research, or speaking on behalf of the Dean’s office in committee settings.
  • Communicate across the university with other executive assistants.

Educational Requirements

  • A minimum of a bachelor’s degree in primary, secondary or higher education (preferred), business administration or a related field. A master’s degree is preferred.
  • At least three years of experience in an administrative role, preferably in an academic setting.
  • Proficiency in the Microsoft Office Suite and familiarity with university management systems.
  • Ability to learn and use resource management systems or applications that are used at the university.
  • Ability to work independently and with others in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong organizational and time management skills.
  • Demonstrated discretion in handling confidential information.

Application Requirements for Positions at the American University of Iraq—Baghdad

Required

  • Cover letter: This should detail how your skills and experience align with the specific requirements of the position you are applying for.
  • Resume/Curriculum Vitae: Please provide an up-to-date resume or CV.
  • Identification: A valid national ID or passport is required for the application process.
  • Please note that applications missing any of these components will not be considered.

Shortlisted Candidates

If you are shortlisted for an interview, you will need to provide additional documentation:

  • Educational transcripts and certifications must be translated into English.
  • References: You must provide contact details for three references. These individuals should be those who have either worked with you or supervised your work.

We look forward to receiving your complete applications and appreciate your interest in joining our dynamic team at AUIB.

title: Analista de Melhoria de Processos Senior
description:
A General Mills está comprometida em ser uma força do bem por meio de uma estratégia global de inclusão para levar diversidade às nossas pessoas e cultura, possibilitando maiores níveis de envolvimento com nossos colaboradores para crescermos junto com nossos clientes e consumidores.
Para nós, criar um ambiente inclusivo e fomentar a diversidade impulsiona o crescimento da companhia, além de dar suporte para o crescimento de nossos colaboradores.

Sobre a posição:

  • Padronizar e melhorar processos produtivos para maximizar os resultados aumentando produtividade e reduzindo perdas, participa e apoia a inovação de produtos na manufatura em escala industrial.

Responsabilidades:

Padronização de processos:

  • Elaborar e revisar lista de materiais (Bill of Materials)
  • Definir padrões de produção: velocidade de linha, número de pessoas, roteiros de produção
  • Definir e elaborar padrões de ajustes de equipamentos (center line) e instruções de trabalho.
  • Capacitar tecnicamente os times operacionais quanto a operação e ajustes nos equipamentos e processos.
  • Elaborar e definir as perdas dos processos e o balanço de massa.
  • Promover um ambiente de trabalho seguro e colaborativo, aderindo às regulamentações de segurança e saúde.

Inovação:

  • Apoiar as áreas de inovação liderando os testes industriais na manufatura para lançamento de novos produtos, embalagens e matérias primas
  • Definir e alterar os padrões da produção de acordo com as inovações e resultados dos testes industriais.

Aumento de produtividade:

  • Liderar projetos de melhoria que envolvam CAPEX;
  • Participar ativamente das análises de causa raiz e propor soluções técnicas para as perdas;
  • Dimensionar a capacidade de produção das linhas atuais e futura;
  • Participar ativamente da mudança de cultura em busca de melhoria contínua através das ferramentas do modelo
  • de gestão Zero Loss.
  • Governar e executar projetos que gerem economia financeira para a companhia, com foco em redução de perdas
  • (Performance e Perdas Base Zero);
  • Liderar, orientar e capacitar as pessoas em Projetos de Melhoria - DMAIC, SMED, Kaizens;

Requisitos:

  • Ensino superior completo (Engenharias: Produção, Alimentos ou afins);
  • Conhecimento e domínio de Pacote Office;
  • Conhecimento em Cultura de Perda Zero;
  • Conhecimento em Lean Manufacturing (Produção Enxuta), IWS – Sistemas de Trabalho Integrado, TPM -
  • Manutenção Produtiva Total, ou WCM – Manufatura Classe Mundial;
  • Ciclo PDCA para análise de causa raiz (Definição de planos de ação – 5W2H, Diagrama de processos; Diagrama de
  • Ishikawa e 5 Porquês);
  • Minímo formado na metodologia DMAIC - Green Belt. Desejável formado na metodologia DMAIC Black Belt;
  • Conhecimentos que serão diferenciais:
  • Conhecimento SAP
  • Ferramentas estatísticas - Minitab
  • Gestão de projetos
  • Metodologia de redução de tempo de setup – SMED;
  • Cronoanálise – Estudo de Tempos e Movimentos;
  • Desejável Inglês Intermediário.
  • Liderar por influência;
  • Disciplina com métodos, prazos e processos;
  • Gerenciar Projetos;
  • Pensamento analítico;
  • Flexibilidade, resiliência e agilidade na tomada de decisões.

Descrição da Empresa

A General Mills é uma empresa líder global em alimentos e trabalha para fazer os alimentos que o mundo ama! Nossas marcas globais incluem Cheerios, Annie's, Yoplait, Nature Valley, Häagen-Dazs, Betty Crocker, Pillsbury, Old El Paso, Wanchai Ferry, Yoki, Blue e muitas outras. Com sede em Minneapolis, Minnesota, EUA, a companhia chegou ao Brasil em 1997, quando iniciou as vendas do sorvete premium Häagen-Dazs. Em 2012, adquiriu o Grupo Yoki Alimentos, conquistando um novo modelo de negócios e tornando-se proprietária das marcas Yoki, Kitano e Mais Vita, reconhecidas pelos brasileiros há décadas. Somos hoje um time apaixonado de 35 mil colaboradores em mais de 100 países e em todos os continentes.

Para você que se identifica e gosta de moda: a ViX Paula Hermanny está procurando um supervisor de corte que será responsável por realizar o acompanhamento das peças a serem cortadas de acordo com o risco e ordem de corte, controle dos modelos e datas de saída de cada pedido, solicitação material e conferência.

Principais atividades:

  1. Planejamento e Organização do Corte
    • Organizar a programação de corte de acordo com a demanda de produção.
    • Definir os materiais e insumos necessários para cada lote de produção.
    • Planejar a sequência de cortes, levando em consideração a otimização do uso de tecido e o aproveitamento máximo do material disponível.
  2. Gestão de Equipe
    • Supervisionar a equipe de corte, garantindo que todos os colaboradores cumpram os padrões e procedimentos estabelecidos.
    • Treinar novos colaboradores e promover o desenvolvimento contínuo da equipe.
    • Realizar a gestão de turnos, escalas e garantir a disciplina e motivação da equipe.
  3. Controle de Qualidade
    • Garantir que os cortes sejam realizados com precisão, seguindo os moldes e especificações do design.
    • Identificar e corrigir problemas de qualidade no corte, como falhas nos moldes ou irregularidades no tecido.
    • Realizar inspeções regulares para verificar a conformidade com as normas de qualidade estabelecidas pela empresa.
  4. Acompanhamento de Produção
    • Monitorar o andamento da produção e verificar se o cronograma de corte está sendo cumprido.
    • Resolver eventuais problemas que possam surgir durante o processo, como falta de material, erro no corte, ou necessidade de ajustes no molde.
    • Realizar a comunicação constante com outros setores, como modelagem, produção e acabamento, para garantir a fluidez do processo.
  5. Gestão de Materiais e Recursos
    • Controlar o estoque de tecidos, garantir o uso adequado dos materiais e evitar desperdícios.
    • Acompanhar a manutenção e conservação das máquinas de corte.
    • Identificar a necessidade de reposição de materiais e insumos e realizar os pedidos de reposição.
  6. Relatórios e Acompanhamento de Resultados
    • Gerar relatórios periódicos sobre a produtividade, desperdícios e eficiência do processo de corte.
    • Acompanhar indicadores de desempenho (KPIs) e sugerir melhorias para otimização do processo.
    • Garantir que os custos com o processo de corte estejam dentro do orçamento estabelecido.
  7. Segurança e Normas
    • Garantir que os procedimentos de segurança sejam seguidos, minimizando riscos de acidentes durante o processo de corte.
    • Cumprir com as normas ambientais, de saúde e segurança no trabalho, implementando ações de prevenção de acidentes.

Requisitos e qualificações:

  1. Ensino médio completo.
  2. Liderança e capacidade de gerenciamento de equipes;
  3. Conhecimento técnico sobre o processo de corte, tipos de tecidos e materiais.
  4. Habilidade para trabalhar com sistemas de controle de produção e relatórios.
  5. Atenção aos detalhes e capacidade de solucionar problemas rapidamente.
  6. Boa comunicação e capacidade de trabalhar de forma colaborativa com outros departamentos.

  • Dinâmica e/ou entrevista com a equipe de Recrutamento: Dinâmica avaliando habilidades específicas necessárias para a função ou discussão sobre as expectativas em relação à vaga e aos objetivos profissionais.

  • Atualização e Capacitação Contínua: Estudar o mercado de franquias, tendências e concorrência, participando de treinamentos e cursos para aprimorar técnicas de vendas consultivas e conhecimentos do setor.

  • Evolve integrations with several third-party APIs including Ad Networks, MMPs, and other data providers

  • Support the decision-making of our Marketing operations through high-quality data products and well-structured dashboards;

We know that the work we do has a high impact on our company's success and culture. The right person for this position is naturally curious, comfortable in a "take the initiative" environment, loves solving problems, is resilient, and can thrive in a fast and growing business.

  • Solve complex and open-ended problems that directly impact one of the most critical areas of the company;
  • Help to evolve and improve the performance of our current solutions and build new data products and systems
  • Be part of a cross-functional team, directly contributing end-to-end to our processes, making sure our products are in production and working properly (final impact);
  • Work in a challenging and fun environment to produce exceptional results.

What you'll need

  • Experience working on designing and developing data-intensive applications in the cloud with technologies such as Spark, SQL, Python, Airflow, etc
  • Excellent high-level communication skills
  • Proficiency in written English

Main Challenges

  • The team is responsible for designing, building, and evolving a big set of complex data-intensive applications including batch data apps, near real-time data ingestion, ML models, and BI pipelines
  • These applications also require the team to build, maintain, and evolve integrations with several third-party APIs including Ad Networks, MMPs, and other data providers used in Digital Marketing
  • As a Senior Data Engineer, you will help the team to ensure high availability, reliability, robustness, performance, cost-effectiveness, and maintainability of the developed solutions
  • We have a multidisciplinary environment and you will interact with people from diverse backgrounds, including Game Engineers, Backend Engineers, Data Scientists, and Product Marketing Managers.

More about you

  • You are impact-driven and interested in learning more about adjacent disciplines (e.g.: Backend, Data Science, etc);
  • You like to solve open-ended problems with non-obvious solutions;
  • You communicate in a structured way both speaking and writing, including in English;
  • You are an excellent teammate and raise the bar of those around you.

About Wildlife

Wildlife is one of the world's leading mobile game developers and publishers. We have released more than 60 titles, reaching billions of people around the globe. Here, we create games that will excite, intrigue, and engage our players for years to come!

Equal Opportunity

Wildlife is proud to be an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. title: Payments Operations Senior Analyst
description:
EBANX is the leading payment platform connecting global companies with customers from the fastest-growing digital markets in the world.

Since the beginning of our journey, we have had one mission: to provide global access for everyone. We believe that transforming challenges into opportunities and making the impossible part of the journey is crucial! That's precisely why we created a payment technology that builds bridges between people and businesses every day in 29 rising markets across the globe.

We call ourselves ebankers, we are global thinkers, we value diversity, we foster creativity and we work hard to connect businesses and people worldwide through payments. Let's make history together?

EBANX is a high-growth technology and payments company with a solid track record of delivering high value to our customers and more than a decade of local expertise, streamlining merchant expansion in rising Latin American, African, and Asian markets with superior performance, service level, and market presence.

The Business Operations Team is responsible for monitoring and leading improving payment approval rates in over 24 countries, continuously driving merchant performance to the next level. We engage with multiple business areas (Products, Engineering, Fraud Prevention, Growth, Commercial and Merchant services teams) and external stakeholders to deliver superior performance on cards, account-based instant transfers and cash-based vouchers, being the leader in local direct connections to payment players and in the offering of Alternative Payment Methods (APMs).

As an Analyst of the Business Operations Team , your mission is to maintain the integrity of EBANX's payment operations, ensure the best quality of payment approval, build strategic relationships with stakeholders, establish business continuity, identify strategic opportunities to improve EBANX performance and provide technical support to internal and external areas:

You will also be responsible for:

  • Monitor and utilize advanced technical skills to analyze key performance indicators (KPIs) of all pillars of approval rates considering the technical and integration characteristics of each acquirers, issuers, BINs, products, API responses, ISO messages review and design and divisions like recurrent and card on file payments, card verification, installments and pre-authorization;
  • Lead and propose deep-dive actions plan to enhance approval rates at the acquirer, partners, issuers and card schemes, propose and execute actions at country level to improve approvals and conversion rates;
  • Design and develop workflows and procedures to streamline payment operations optimizing efficiency and effectiveness;
  • Build and manage relationships with payments partners (acquirers, issuers, card schemes and external providers) to ensure optimal performance and operations continuity and also collaborate with partners to implement strategies to improve approval rates;
  • Conduct A/B Test with acquirers, focusing on enhancing approval rates and evaluating country approval strategies;
  • Be on top of Market and Technology trends in the payments industry, mapping opportunities and recommendations to improve EBANX payment operations and approval rates and proactively adapt our operational strategies accordingly;
  • Create dashboards visualizations on Kibana/Grafana enabling deeper and specific analysis for conversion rate, such as creating queries for SQL consults and analysis;
  • Analyze real-time data to identify patterns and trends that can enhance the efficiency and accuracy of Smart Routing strategies using advanced Machine Learning (ML) techniques;
  • Detect anomalies and handle alerts based on Machine Learning algorithm and work on the continuous improvement of the monitoring tool, refining the algorithm and dashboards;
  • Collaborate with internal stakeholders Products, Engineering, Fraud Prevention, Data Analytics, Commercial, Merchant Operations and Business Architecture to guarantee and deliver the best approval rates to our merchants.

Main requirements for this position:

  • Previous experience in the payments industry, e-commerce or similar;
  • A self-starter who is comfortable working in a fast-paced and data-driven environment;
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret complex data sets and derive actionable insights;
  • Tenacious and resilient with a positive and solution-oriented attitude;
  • Detail-oriented mindset with a focus on continuous improvement and optimization;
  • Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets skills;

What would be a Plus:

  • Experience in process mapping and technical documentation;
  • Knowledge about smart routing, anti-fraud solutions, card schemes authorization products;
  • Experience with data visualization and analytical tools (Tableau, Kibana);
  • Project management, roadmap and organization;
  • Ability to manage and handle complex situations;
  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Technology or related field;
  • Exceptional communication, presentation and negotiation skills;
  • Advanced SQL to write, review and join queries across multiple databases;
  • Advanced English or Spanish;

description:
Sobre nós

Nossa história começou em 2001, com um pequeno escritório de agentes autônomos de investimentos em Porto Alegre e hoje somos um grande ecossistema de serviços financeiros, mídia e educação.

Chegamos até aqui com a dedicação de equipes talentosas que tiveram garra, determinação, resiliência e, acima de tudo, ambição de fazer o impossível.

Nossos valores

  • Foco no cliente: Somos obstinados em superar as expectativas dos nossos clientes.
  • Sonho grande: Miramos no impossível, acreditamos que ele pode se tornar realidade, e chegamos lá juntos.
  • Mente aberta: Nossa abertura para o novo e nossa capacidade de adaptação são o que nos fazem evoluir e melhorar sempre.
  • Espírito empreendedor: Construímos o futuro com nossas próprias mãos com o mais alto nível de comprometimento e sentimento de dono.

Sobre a Oportunidade

Tem perfil comercial, busca transição de carreira e quer fazer parte de um time de alta performance?

Conheça o XP Future - Campinas, uma iniciativa disruptiva para profissionais com alto skill comercial e que desejam se tornar assessores de investimentos.

Essa é uma oportunidade para profissionais estão em busca de uma transição de carreira e possuem experiência comercial para migrarem para o mercado financeiro.

Na XP Inc. você terá todo o suporte para uma rápida integração e consolidação de seu novo escopo em assessoria, desenvolvendo e aprimorando habilidades de vendas, prospecção de clientes, aprofundamento nos produtos de investimentos e, principalmente, uma imersão no dia a dia do mercado financeiro. Além disso, o programa conta com uma esteira robusta de carreira para que você se torne um profissional comercial de sucesso na corretora, e tire a certificação CPA-20 para se tornar um assessor referência no mercado!

Se você já possui experiência comercial em outros segmentos e deseja fazer uma transição de carreira para o mercado financeiro, conheça os pré-requisitos para iniciar no XP Future logo abaixo!

O Que Procuramos

Pré-requisitos Essenciais:

  • Ter a nossa cultura;
  • Graduação superior completa ou estar cursando o último ano em período noturno;
  • Ter disponibilidade para trabalhar em modelo híbrido em Campinas;
  • Perfil comercial e relacional;
  • Experiência comercial (diferencial como Hunter - prospecção de novos negócios);
  • Curiosidade sobre o mundo dos investimentos;
  • Interesse por realizar uma transição de carreira;
  • Estar atuando em outros segmentos de mercado (Meios de pagamentos, adquirência, bebidas, fintechs, etc);
  • Não ser um Assessor de Investimentos ou Agente Autônomo (AAI)

Diferenciais:

  • Conhecimento sobre produtos financeiros (RF, RV, fundos e outros);
  • CPA-20 ou CEA (Caso o candidato aprovado não tenha a certificação do CPA-20, fornecemos o curso de forma gratuita, em parceria com a Academia Rafael Toro)

Desafios e Impacto:

  • Atuação no segmento de Assessoria de Investimentos, sendo responsável por aconselhar e auxiliar a gestão de patrimônio dos clientes;
  • Elaboração de portfólio de investimentos em linha com o perfil e objetivo dos clientes;
  • Análise de alocações externas, elaboração de estudos comparativos exclusivos e identificando oportunidades;
  • Acompanhamento de tendências de mercado, se mantendo sempre informado sobre atualidades do cenário econômico;
  • Disciplina para manter um alta frequência de contato com clientes de forma online e presencial.

Obs.: a contratação é CLT.

Essa vaga é destinada a um pool de rede de talentos a nível Brasil, então pode ser que o retorno demore um pouco a mais do que outras vagas da XP! Em paralelo, também estão abertas as vagas dos XDays XP Future (vagas que acontecerão processos seletivos presenciais na cidade divulgada) para você se aplicar! Essas oportunidades se encontram aqui: Oportunidades XP Inc. ou

Etapas do Processo:

  1. Triagem inicial : Análise do currículo para verificar a adequação às qualificações e requisitos da vaga.

  2. Testes gerais : Avaliação do alinhamento cultural com o teste da Mindsight e teste de raciocínio lógico da Predictive Index.

  3. Entrevista com a equipe de Recrutamento : Discussão sobre as expectativas em relação à vaga e aos objetivos profissionais.

  4. Entrevista com a liderança : Uma conversa para discutir sua visão e como você pode contribuir para a equipe e a empresa.

  5. Entrevista com Head Comercial : Conversa para discutir sobre o seu perfil e características necessárias para contribuir com a operação.

  6. Entrevista focada em cultura : Exploração dos valores e princípios da empresa para garantir um bom encaixe cultural.

  7. Oferta : Apresentação da proposta de trabalho, incluindo detalhes sobre remuneração e benefícios.

Por fim, abaixo segue o vídeo sobre o Fator XP! Para você se reconhecer cada vez mais no nosso propósito como empresa e cultura:

Benefícios que oferecemos:

  • Saúde e bem-estar: plano de saúde, plano odontológico, Gympass, Zenklub, VA, VR, New Value, seguro de vida.
  • Maternidade e Paternidade: auxílio creche para pais e mães, licença maternidade de 6 meses, licença paternidade de 20 dias.
  • Só na XP Inc.: assessoria de investimento e acesso a fundos de investimentos exclusivos.

Jornada de trabalho com flexibilidade:

O nosso modelo de trabalho varia de acordo com a função: presencial para frentes de negócio e híbrido para as demais equipes. É importante ressaltar que todos os colaboradores precisam morar na localidade da vaga (nossa sede está localizada na cidade de São Paulo e é onde temos o maior número de posições), já que temos atividades que exigem a presença física para promover a colaboração e os rituais da nossa cultura. Esses encontros são organizados de acordo com as orientações dos líderes e as particularidades de cada rotina, para que nossos colaboradores possam exercer suas jornadas de trabalho com liberdade e autonomia.

A LPJ é uma das principais consultorias SAP do Brasil, com mais de 20 anos de experiência em gestão de processos, tecnologia, negócios e pessoas. Como organização de capital nacional, temos o compromisso de oferecer soluções personalizadas e construir relações de longo prazo, valorizando o investimento e a confiança de nossos clientes.

Nossa missão é promover resultados sustentáveis, com foco em qualidade e cumprimento de prazos. Investimos continuamente no desenvolvimento de nossos consultores certificados, assegurando que nossa equipe esteja sempre atualizada e preparada para entregar excelência em cada projeto.

O que esperamos deste profissional:

Buscamos um Arquiteto ABAP com forte expertise em SAP S/4HANA e conhecimento em SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP) para liderar a construção de soluções modernas, escaláveis e integradas dentro do ecossistema SAP.   1. Definir e evoluir a arquitetura técnica de soluções SAP baseadas em SAP ECC, S/4HANA e BTP;

  8. Atuar como referência técnica para desenvolvedores e consultores funcionais em todo o ciclo de vida dos projetos.

Requisitos:

  2. Experiência comprovada em projetos com SAP S/4HANA;
  3. Conhecimentos em SAP Fiori/UI5 e SAP Gateway;
  4. Experiência com metodologias ágeis e DevOps em ambientes SAP;
  5. Habilidade para atuar de forma consultiva com áreas técnicas e de negócio;
  6. Certificações SAP (ABAP for S/4HANA, BTP, Fiori, etc.);
  7. Experiência com a SAP BTP (principalmente CAP, SAP Cloud SDK, SAP Build, Integration Suite, Workflow, etc.);
  8. Vivência com integrações via SAP API Management e SAP Event Mesh;
  9. Experiência prática com extensões Side-by-Side na BTP;
  10. Conhecimento em arquitetura orientada a eventos e microsserviços no contexto SAP.
